basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, studying computer science. I've recently gotten into gaming and modding, especially games like Undertale and Brawl Stars. When I'm not hitting the books or gaming, I enjoy exploring indie music and occasionally dabbling in digital art. I'm typically online in the evenings, after classes and part-time work as a barista. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer science principles from my college coursework. My interest in modding is pretty new, and I'm mostly self-taught through online resources and trial and error. I enjoy learning by doing, which sometimes leads to trial and error, as seen with my current modding challenges.
